description: Modoc County – Today, California Assembly District 1 candidate Heather Hadwick announces the endorsement of Siskiyou County Supervisor Michael Kobseff. Supervisor Michael Kobseff has been a resident of Siskiyou County for 54 years. For 30 years, Michael and his wife, Lynn, owned and operated a local restaurant in Mount Shasta.
